name: agentic-claude
description: 8 specialized AI agents, 8 production-ready skills, and 4 team compositions for Claude Code. One-shot setup for Windows and Mac/Linux. Built for IBM APIC/ACE/MQ integrations and enterprise software teams.
longDescription: Agentic-Claude provides a plug-and-play team of specialized Claude Code agents for enterprise software projects. Agents cover the full development lifecycle: implementation (developer), testing (tester), infrastructure (devops), documentation (documentarian), integration architecture (architect), and orchestration (product-owner-assistant). Skills automate common workflows: feature development, code review, security audits, CI/CD, and documentation sync. Team blueprints orchestrate multiple agents for end-to-end features, releases, and migrations. Includes one-shot setup scripts, auto model-update tooling, and CI validation. Designed for IBM APIC/ACE/MQ integration teams at TCS.
features: 8 specialized agents: developer, tester, devops, architect, documentarian, product-owner-assistant, librarian, library-engineer
4 team blueprints: feature-team, release-team, full-team, repo-improvement-team
Auto model-update: update.ps1/update.sh keep agents on the latest Claude models
Installation doctor: doctor.ps1/doctor.sh diagnose broken setups
GitHub Actions: CI validation, release automation, monthly model-watcher
IBM APIC/ACE/MQ specific patterns in architect agent and /security-audit skill
Hooks: branch guardrail, commit-guard, agent orchestration reminders
